content: Cross-checked browser game-loop references recommend separating fixed-step simulation from variable-rate rendering. requestAnimationFrame supplies elapsed wall time; an accumulator drains bounded fixed simulation steps; rendering reads state and may interpolate. Keeping simulation pure and browser APIs at adapters makes takeoff, flight, landing, and scoring deterministic and directly unit-testable. For this tiny game, an ECS, event bus, WASM layer, or general physics engine would add boundaries without useful scale.
